fields.label: BOM Type
fields.description: Development and Bulk Style BOMs can both generate native ERPNext BOMs after production gates pass.

fields.label: BOM Generation Mode
fields.options:
Per Colourway (Material-wise)
Per SKU (Colour x Size)
fields.description: Required before Generate Production BOMs will run. Per SKU is the Manufacturing-ready mode: it creates one exact native ERPNext BOM per colour x size on the real sellable SKU Item, available to ERPNext Production Plans and Work Orders. Per Colourway creates one shared, size-weighted BOM per colour on a non-sellable carrier Item and is for costing/planning only. Editable after submit so a Style BOM submitted before choosing a mode is not permanently stuck.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: 1 on first submit. Incremented on each amend.

fields.label: Style BOM Override
fields.description: Only add a row when a specific colourway/size needs to deviate from a line's base value.
